name: AnimJoint
doc: A joint in parent-before-child order, with stable importer identity. Reflected as AnimJoint (the physics Joint component owns the bare name); documents never name it, so the rename needs no document migration.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Stable joint identifier, preserved when its display name changes.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Index of the parent joint; absent for a root.

fields.name: bind
fields.doc: Local bind transform relative to the parent.

fields.name: retarget
fields.doc: Retargeting metadata preserved by the cooked skeleton.
